Quote.description: 1.0.0 (B6): a constant-product pool swap quote — the reference client's pool pricing (network/shapes/Pool, BigInt, floors matching LibPool) over the mirror's reserves. Chain-exact: gate G2.e compares it against on-chain reserves at the same block, both directions, both modes. The amounts are integers in item units.

mode.description: EXACT_IN: sell exactly the amount; EXACT_OUT (--exact-out): buy at least the amount

amountIn.description: what the swap takes. EXACT_OUT: the smallest input whose output covers the ask (calcAmountIn, rounded up)

amountOut.description: what the chain pays for amountIn (calcAmountOut, rounded down). EXACT_OUT: >= the amount asked for, usually equal. Use it as the swap's minAmountOut bound, less any slippage allowance.

feeAmountIn.description: the fee share of amountIn in input units, amountIn × feeBps / 10000; may be fractional (the pool keeps it as reserve)

spotAmountOut.description: amountIn at the pre-trade reserve ratio, no fee, no impact: floor(amountIn × reserveOut / reserveIn)

priceImpactBps.description: the curve's cost beyond the fee, in basis points of the fee-adjusted ideal output (display figure, rounded; the amounts are exact)

reservesAfter.description: [from-side reserve, to-side reserve] after this swap — the whole amountIn enters, amountOut leaves
